cards.front: Los vegetarianos comen fruta y verdura.
cards.back: Vegetarians eat fruit and vegetables.

cards.front: Los carnívoros comen carne.
cards.back: Carnivores eat meat.

cards.front: ¡Los omnívoros comen de todo!
cards.back: Omnivores eat everything!

cards.front: Los vegetarianos no comen carne roja.
cards.back: Vegetarians don't eat red meat.

cards.front: Algunos vegetarianos no comen pescado.
cards.back: Some vegetarians don't eat fish.

cards.front: Algunos omnívoros no comen coles de Bruselas.
cards.back: Some omnivores don't eat sprouts!

cards.front: ¿Las vacas comen hierba? Sí, las vacas comen hierba.
cards.back: Do cows eat grass? Yes, cows eat grass.

cards.front: ¿Los osos hormigueros comen hormigas? Sí, los osos hormigueros comen hormigas.
cards.back: Do anteaters eat ants? Yes, anteaters eat ants.

cards.front: ¿Los gatos comen vacas? No, los gatos no comen vacas.
cards.back: Do cats eat cows? No, cats don't eat cows.

cards.front: ¿Los caballos beben cerveza? No, no beben cerveza.
cards.back: Do horses drink beer? No, they don't drink beer.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no beben cerveza? Porque beben agua.
cards.back: Why don't they drink beer? Because they drink water.

cards.front: ¿Bebes agua rápidamente?
cards.back: Do you drink water quickly?

cards.front: Sí, bebo agua rápidamente.
cards.back: Yes, I drink water quickly.

cards.front: ¿Por qué bebes agua tan rápidamente?
cards.back: Why do you drink water so quickly?

cards.front: Él siempre come algo entre horas.
cards.back: He always has something to eat between meals.

cards.front: Ella de vez en cuando come algo entre horas.
cards.back: She sometimes has something to eat between meals.

cards.front: Ellos comen algo entre horas a menudo.
cards.back: They often have something to eat between meals.

cards.front: Yo siempre desayuno sobre las 08:00.
cards.back: I always have breakfast at around 8 a.m.

cards.front: Nosotros almorzamos sobre las 15:00 de vez en cuando.
cards.back: We sometimes have lunch at around 3 p.m.

cards.front: Tú cenas sobre las 21:00 a menudo.
cards.back: You often have dinner at around 9 p.m.

cards.front: Yo siempre tomo algo para beber después del trabajo.
cards.back: I always have something to drink after work.

cards.front: James toma un café antes del trabajo a menudo.
cards.back: James often has a coffee before work.

cards.front: Caroline toma un café en el trabajo de vez en cuando.
cards.back: Caroline sometimes has a coffee at work.

cards.front: Vamos a algún sitio bueno a coger algo para comer.
cards.back: Let's go grab something to eat from somewhere nice.

cards.front: Vamos a algún sitio barato a coger algo para comer.
cards.back: Let's go grab some food from somewhere cheap.

cards.front: Vamos a algún sitio donde haga calorcito a coger algo para comer.
cards.back: Let's go grab some food from somewhere warm.

cards.front: Vamos a coger algo para comer en algún sitio bueno.
cards.back: Let's grab a bite to eat somewhere nice.

cards.front: Vamos a coger algo para comer en algún sitio barato.
cards.back: Let's grab a bite to eat somewhere cheap.

cards.front: Vamos a coger algo para comer en algún sitio donde haga calorcito.
cards.back: Let's grab a bite to eat somewhere warm.

cards.front: Hoy comemos en casa.
cards.back: We're eating in today.

cards.front: ¿Por qué coméis en casa hoy?
cards.back: Why are you eating in today?

cards.front: Comemos en casa hoy para ahorrar dinero.
cards.back: We're eating in today to save money.

cards.front: Solo como fuera de casa en ocasiones especiales.
cards.back: I only eat out on special occasions.

cards.front: ¡Es una ocasión especial! ¡Cenemos fuera esta noche!
cards.back: It's a special occasion! Let's eat out tonight!

cards.front: No quiero comer fuera. No es una ocasión especial.
cards.back: I don't want to eat out. It's not a special occasion.

cards.front: Siempre salimos a cenar en las grandes ocasiones.
cards.back: We always go out for dinner on special occasions.

cards.front: Es una gran ocasión. ¡Salgamos a cenar!
cards.back: It's a special occasion. Let's go out for dinner!

cards.front: No quiero salir a cenar. No es una gran ocasión.
cards.back: I don't want to go out for dinner. It's not a special occasion.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no salimos a tomar algo? (a drink)
cards.back: Why don't we go out for a drink?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no salimos a tomar algo? (drinks)
cards.back: Why don't we go out for some drinks?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no salimos a tomar un café?
cards.back: Why don't we go out for a coffee?

cards.front: ¡Vamos a por comida para llevar!
cards.back: Let's grab a takeaway!

cards.front: ¿Por qué vas a por comida para llevar?
cards.back: Why are you grabbing a takeaway?

cards.front: Voy a por comida para llevar porque no quiero cocinar.
cards.back: I'm grabbing a takeaway because I don't want to cook.

cards.front: Las bebidas con gas me dan acidez.
cards.back: Fizzy drinks give me heartburn.

cards.front: Las bebidas con gas me producen indigestión.
cards.back: Fizzy drinks give me indigestion.

cards.front: Las bebidas con gas me dan dolores de cabeza.
cards.back: Fizzy drinks give me headaches.

cards.front: ¿Te dan acidez los refrescos?
cards.back: Do soft drinks give you heartburn?

cards.front: ¿Te dan indigestión los refrescos?
cards.back: Do soft drinks give you indigestion?

cards.front: ¿Te dan dolores de cabeza los refrescos?
cards.back: Do soft drinks give you headaches?

cards.front: ¿Sale cara la comida en aquel restaurante?
cards.back: Is the food in that restaurant overpriced?

cards.front: Sí, la comida en aquel restaurante sale cara.
cards.back: Yes, the food in that restaurant is overpriced.

cards.front: No, la comida en aquel restaurante no sale cara.
cards.back: No, the food in that restaurant isn't overpriced.

cards.front: Él come tres comidas completas al día.
cards.back: He eats three square meals a day.

cards.front: ¿Comes tres comidas completas al día?
cards.back: Do you eat three square meals a day?

cards.front: No, no como tres comidas completas al día.
cards.back: No, I don't eat three square meals a day.

cards.front: ¿Cuál es el plato del día?
cards.back: What's the dish of the day?

cards.front: El plato del día es pollo al horno.
cards.back: The dish of the day is roast chicken.

cards.front: Yo tomaré el plato del día entonces, por favor.
cards.back: I'll have the dish of the day then, please.

cards.front: Camarero, este plato lleva demasiada sal.
cards.back: Waiter, this dish is too salty.

cards.front: ¿De verdad está demasiado salado?
cards.back: Is it really too salty?

cards.front: Sí. Seguro que está demasiado salado.
cards.back: Yes. It's definitely too salty.

cards.front: ¿Le gusta su café amargo a usted?
cards.back: Do you like your coffee bitter?

cards.front: Sí, me gusta el café bastante amargo.
cards.back: Yes, I like it quite bitter.

cards.front: Bastante amargo, pero no demasiado amargo.
cards.back: Quite bitter but not too bitter.

cards.front: Este pomelo está demasiado agrio.
cards.back: This grapefruit is too sour!

cards.front: ¿Qué espera usted? El pomelo es una fruta agria.
cards.back: What do you expect? Grapefruit is a sour fruit.

cards.front: Sí, pero este pomelo está verdaderamente agrio.
cards.back: Yes, but this grapefruit is really sour!

cards.front: La comida picante me pone malo o mala.
cards.back: Spicy food makes me ill.

cards.front: La comida picante me hace sudar.
cards.back: Spicy food makes me sweat.

cards.front: La comida picante me hace toser.
cards.back: Spicy food makes me cough.

cards.front: ¿Está el vino demasiado dulce?
cards.back: Is the wine too sweet?

cards.front: Sí, el vino está demasiado dulce.
cards.back: Yes, the wine's too sweet.

cards.front: No me gusta el vino dulce, prefiero el seco.
cards.back: I don't like sweet wine, I prefer dry.

cards.front: ¿Alguna vez te muerdes el labio al comer?
cards.back: Do you ever bite your lip when you're eating?

cards.front: Mi hijo siempre se muerde el labio al comer.
cards.back: My son always bites his lip when he's eating.

cards.front: Yo nunca me muerdo el labio al comer.
cards.back: I never bite my lip when I'm eating.

cards.front: ¡No mastiques tan ruidosamente!
cards.back: Don't chew so loudly!

cards.front: ¡Mastica con la boca cerrada!
cards.back: Chew with your mouth closed!

cards.front: ¡Mastica bien!
cards.back: Chew properly!

cards.front: Prueba este estofado, está delicioso.
cards.back: Taste this stew, it's amazing.

cards.front: Prueba esta tarta, está deliciosa.
cards.back: Taste this pie, it's amazing.

cards.front: Prueba este postre, está delicioso.
cards.back: Taste this dessert, it's amazing.

cards.front: No te tragues un hueso.
cards.back: Don't swallow a bone.

cards.front: No te tragues tus chicles.
cards.back: Don't swallow your chewing gum.

cards.front: No te tragues tu enjuague bucal.
cards.back: Don't swallow your mouthwash.

cards.front: ¡Él se está atragantando con el estofado!
cards.back: He's choking on his stew!

cards.front: ¡Ella se está atragantando con el chicle!
cards.back: She's choking on her chewing gum!

cards.front: ¡Él se está atragantando con la tarta!
cards.back: He's choking on his pie!
